mentor_context: Mentors focus exclusively on technical upskilling, failing to prepare mentees for the behavioral transition required for senior consulting success.
Senior consulting success is predicted with 92.7% accuracy by Openness (AOR=7.72) and Conscientiousness (AOR=8.11); Neuroticism has zero held-out predictive value.
Conduct monthly roleplay simulations where mentees navigate difficult, ambiguous client scenarios, scope changes, and executive pushback.
Encourage mentees to work across unfamiliar business domains (e.g. pivoting from retail churn to manufacturing supply chain) to build cognitive adaptability.
Instill extreme rigor in documentation, stakeholder follow-up, meeting recaps, and reproducible artifact delivery.
Mentees achieve >=90% stakeholder approval ratings on complex projects; successful promotion from individual contributor to consulting lead within 24 months.
Strict ethical boundary: Never use Big Five personality scores to judge or categorize a mentee's character; focus on observable communication behaviors.
